worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.summary: Crouch and pivot to carve a low ground-hugging arc: every foe in the arc takes the cut on the shins, and a target that was moving fast cannot recover its balance, losing the most Speed; one cut hard enough also pins its leg for an instant. A spinning sweep opens a wider arc and pins longer, for a lighter cut.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.0: A living hit takes %1$s contact damage; a target cut on the shins drops %2$s Speed stages (other combatants get it on their movement speed).
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.1: Attack targets within a %1$s-degree arc and %2$s-block reach.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.2: The hobbled identity lasts %1$s; a target that cannot recover its balance has the leg pinned %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.whirl.on: Spinning sweep: a wider arc and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter cut and longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.whirl.off: Point cut: a faster, heavier small-arc sweep that only shaves the space in front.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.growth.0: From level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.growth.1: From level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s and the wound lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.use.0: Cut a fast target's Speed at close range
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.use.2: Pivot-sweep the small ring at the feet
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.preference.wh: On: a wider sweep arc and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter cut and longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a faster, heavier small-arc cut.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.preference.ai: It closes in before sweeping beyond this distance. Larger values commit from further out; smaller values only cut in melee.
On: prefer a fast-moving target (a deeper Speed drop). Off: treat it as an ordinary melee candidate.
